title: Invite other stores to Pilotix
paused: The referral programme is paused for now.
h1: Share your link (WhatsApp, Facebook) or give your code.
h2: The store signs up with it: you are told (e-mail and notification).
h3: At its first payment, you get {{months}} free month(s), added by themselves to your subscription.
h4: One reward per store; your own store does not count.

promo.title: Welcome promo code
promo.intro: A unique code, sent by itself to people who come from an « Awareness 🎁 » post or ad. Once per account, usable once.
promo.minHint: Products’ total before the discount (0: none)
promo.daysHint: Counted from when the code is sent
promo.wordHint: After following the page, the person sends this word
promo.rulesNote: Products only (not delivery). The code may go above a product’s maximum discount; other discounts keep the limit. One order, one time (several products allowed). The same phone can use different codes.
promo.textsHelp: {code} = the code · {remise} = the discount · {min} = the minimum · {date} = the end · {mot} = the word to send. These messages go by themselves: not the AI.
promo.postsGo: Mark them in Pilot Comments › Posts
promo.adsHelp: A chat started from a ticked ad gets the code.
promo.noAds: No ad known yet: add an ad ID.
promo.refsHelp: A link m.me/yourpage?ref=VALUE: a chat opened with this value gets the code.
